description: Deterministic-plumbing retrieval fixture. Five topics have deliberately disjoint vocabulary so the FNV-1a test embedder makes expected neighbors construction-stable. Recall@K/MRR assert wiring, ranking, and forbidden-result handling; they are explicitly not a real-embedding semantic-quality claim. Sampled real-model quality belongs to M-27.
